name: Hitoyoshi (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Hitoyoshi city emblem in black: a stylised device of a winged top above a swirl, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Hitoyoshi, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 7 October 1972.

features.role: Hitoyoshi city emblem — a stylised device of a winged top above a swirl, like a stylised character
